page.overview:
Who is Abraham Lincoln (Android)?

However, the Mark Twain android was not disabled, and was able to hide himself and several other androids (including Lincoln) from the S.H.I.E.L.D clean-up crew, and later he repaired the others. These androids concluded that while the Mad Thinker had provided them with plenty of philosophical knowledge, they knew little about humanity. They were able to pool their resources and contact the Vision, an android with lots of experience with humanity, to teach them. The Vision agreed to teach them, but shortly afterward a damaged Fyodor Dostoyevsky android found them, followed by an angry mob who thought Dostoyevsky was a serial killer, Spider-Man, and the real serial killer. After a large conflict which was eventually resolved when the real serial killer was identified and captured, the androids decided to take Dostoyevsky and retreat into isolation while they considered their next move, instead of continuing their instruction with the Vision.

The Mad Thinker eventually returned to the Ponder laboratory and evicted the androids. Many of the androids went on to found the town of Nüponder, Michigan. It is unknown if Lincoln was among them.
